title: 阿萝拉·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 成年兔族保留直立长耳，红橙头发配圆框眼镜与细小雀斑。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Aurora is an adult rabbit vastaya with long upright rabbit ears, red-orange hair, round spectacles, soft freckles, and a large rabbit tail. Preserve her scholarly witchlike identity, warm travel layers, and recognizable green-brown colors. A fully covering coat, opaque tights, gloves, and boots keep the figure modest; her compact wand or staff is carried quietly lowered, with no active spell.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: moss green, ginger orange, cool stone, silver-blue light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
